title: BIO 102 ( UNN ) : CHAPTER SEVEN ( RECENT ADVANCES IN GENETIC ENGINEERING )
subject: BIO 102

questions.question: Recombinant DNA technology involves the joining of DNA molecules from which source?
questions.explanation: Recombinant DNA technology involves joining DNA molecules from two different species.

questions.question: The study and science of biochemistry initially focused on which subject?
questions.explanation: Biochemistry initially just focused on the study of the chemistry of living things.

questions.question: Genetic engineering is used to produce individuals with which feature?
questions.explanation: Genetic engineering produces individuals having a new combination of inherited properties.

questions.question: Cellular manipulation involves the collection of which type of cells?
questions.explanation: Cellular manipulation involves the collection of haploid cells.

questions.question: Fusion of somatic cells leads to the formation of which structure?
questions.explanation: Cellular manipulation often leads to cell fusion and the formation of a single hybrid cell.

questions.question: Which substance is used as a fusogen to induce cell fusion?
questions.explanation: Cell fusion may be induced by treatment with fusogens like killed Sendai virus or polyethylene glycol.

questions.question: Formation of hybridoma cells is an important step for the production of which product?
questions.explanation: Hybridoma cells are important for the technique of forming monoclonal antibodies.

questions.question: Molecular manipulation involves the construction of which type of molecules?
questions.explanation: Molecular manipulation involves the construction of artificial recombinant DNA molecules.

questions.question: Insertion of DNA molecules into a host cell is referred to by which term?
questions.explanation: Insertion of DNA molecules into a host cell is often referred to as recombinant DNA technology.

questions.question: DNA sequencing may lead to the ability to predict which structure of a protein?
questions.explanation: DNA sequencing may lead to the ability to predict the primary structure of a protein.

questions.question: Human insulin for the treatment of diabetes is produced using which technique?
questions.explanation: The synthesis of recombinant protein has led to the production of human insulin.

questions.question: DNA probes are essential for identifying which type of genes?
questions.explanation: DNA probes are essential for aberrant genes which are the causes of numerous diseases.

questions.question: Gene therapy involves the incorporation of DNA into which part of a person?
questions.explanation: Gene therapy incorporates DNA into a person's genome to treat disease.

questions.question: Gene splicing is a biochemical or chemical manipulation with which objective?
questions.explanation: Gene splicing aims to attach one DNA molecule to another.

questions.question: Which enzyme is used to cleave DNA to yield single stranded ends?
questions.explanation: Restriction endonuclease cleaves DNA to yield single stranded complementary ends.

questions.question: The complementary ends of two DNA molecules are covalently joined by which enzyme?
questions.explanation: DNA ligase covalently joins the complementary ends of the two DNA molecules.

questions.question: If restriction endonuclease produces blunt ends, which enzyme may be used to add nucleotides?
questions.explanation: Terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase is used to add nucleotides to the 3' terminal OH group.

questions.question: Gene cloning involves the isolation of a bacterial cell containing which type of DNA?
questions.explanation: Gene cloning involves the isolation of a bacterial cell of a fragment of any heterologous DNA.

questions.question: The DNA to be cloned may be a fragment of genomic DNA obtained by which method?
questions.explanation: The DNA to be cloned may be a fragment of genomic DNA obtained by restriction endonuclease digestion.

questions.question: In cloning using plasmid vectors, plasmids are reintroduced into host cells by which process?
questions.explanation: In cloning using plasmid vectors, plasmids are reintroduced into host cells by transformation.

questions.question: Markers on the cloning vectors allow the selection of cells containing which component?
questions.explanation: Markers on the cloning vectors allow selection of plasmid-containing cells and identification of those containing recombinant plasmid.

questions.question: To identify clones containing particular sequences, DNA from individual colonies is screened using which tool?
questions.explanation: DNA from individual colonies may be screened with a labelled DNA probe by colony hybridization.

questions.question: Genetic engineering allows the introduction or removal of what?
questions.explanation: Genetic engineering allows us to introduce a defined trait with the aid of a vector.

questions.question: Gene therapy can resolve a genetic defect by which method?
questions.explanation: Gene therapy can resolve a genetic defect by completely exterminating the defective gene.

questions.question: A somatic cell is any normal cell of an organism that is not involved in which process?
questions.explanation: A somatic cell is not involved in reproduction.

questions.question: A fusogen is a substance that facilitates which cellular process?
questions.explanation: A fusogen facilitates cell fusion.

questions.question: The biochemical knowledge has opened new windows into which applied field?
questions.explanation: Biochemical knowledge has opened new areas including genetic engineering.

questions.question: Which technique involves obtaining nuclei and cytoplasm from different cells?
questions.explanation: Cell fusion involves obtaining nuclei and cytoplasm from different cells.

questions.question: Recombinant DNA technology is a branch of which broader scientific field?
questions.explanation: Recombinant DNA technology is an area of biotechnology.

questions.question: A vector used in molecular manipulation is established in which type of entity?
questions.explanation: DNA is inserted into a vector and established in a host organism.

questions.question: The production of human growth hormones is used to treat children with which condition?
questions.explanation: Human growth hormones are for administration to children with growth defects.

questions.question: Gene therapy treats disease by incorporating DNA that encodes which type of product?
questions.explanation: Gene therapy incorporates DNA that encodes a specific therapeutic protein.

questions.question: Terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase adds nucleotides to which position of a DNA chain?
questions.explanation: The enzyme adds nucleotides to the 3' terminal OH group of a DNA chain.

questions.question: The use of DNA probes has led to the production of a vaccine for which disease?
questions.explanation: The technique has led to the production of a vaccine for hepatitis B.

questions.question: A discussion on gene therapy is inconclusive without mentioning which technique?
questions.explanation: A discussion on gene therapy is inconclusive without mentioning gene splicing.

questions.question: The latest method to cleave DNA for insertion uses which enzyme to yield single stranded ends?
questions.explanation: The latest method uses a restriction endonuclease to yield single stranded ends.

questions.question: When inserting foreign DNA into a cloning vector, both are treated with which substance to allow association?
questions.explanation: The cloning vector is treated with the same endonuclease so that complementary ends associate.

questions.question: The complementary ends of foreign DNA and cloning vector specifically associate under which conditions?
questions.explanation: Complementary ends specifically associate under annealing conditions.

questions.question: The covalently joined DNA molecules are spliced through the action of which enzyme?
questions.explanation: The DNA is subsequently covalently joined through the action of DNA ligase.

questions.question: If foreign DNA and cloning vector have no common restriction sites, which enzyme may be used?
questions.explanation: Terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase may be used if there are no common restriction sites.

questions.question: In gene cloning, what is the purpose of obtaining a homogenous population of DNA molecules?
questions.explanation: The isolation is done in order to obtain a homogenous population, i.e., clone, of DNA molecules.

questions.question: The production of human insulin has been facilitated by the synthesis of which product?
questions.explanation: The synthesis of recombinant protein has led to the production of human insulin.

questions.question: Which technique is essential for the formation of hybridoma cells for monoclonal antibodies?
questions.explanation: Cell fusion is an important step in the technique of forming hybridoma cells.

questions.question: The manipulation of recombinant DNA has many important applications in which field?
questions.explanation: Recombinant DNA technology is an area of biotechnology with many important applications.

questions.question: DNA probes are used in which technique to screen DNA from individual colonies?
questions.explanation: DNA from individual colonies may be screened with a labelled DNA probe by colony hybridization.

questions.question: Genetic engineering allows the introduction of a defined trait with the aid of which tool?
questions.explanation: Genetic engineering allows us to introduce a defined trait with the aid of a vector.

questions.question: Which molecule is inserted into a host cell or organism during molecular manipulation?
questions.explanation: Artificial recombinant DNA molecules are inserted into a host cell or organism.

questions.question: The insertion of foreign DNA into a cloning vector requires the vector to be cleaned with which substance?
questions.explanation: The cloning vector is cleaned with a restriction enzyme.

questions.question: The gaps between vector and insert DNA are sealed with which enzyme?
questions.explanation: The gaps between vector and insert DNA are sealed with DNA ligase.

questions.question: Gene therapy can resolve a genetic defect by completely exterminating which entity?
questions.explanation: Gene therapy can resolve a genetic defect by completely exterminating the defective gene.
